jess (CSM): Hey all — quick weekly check-in for Nebula Payments (onboarding). Heads up: error rate spike this week. 5xx up from 3.2% -> 8.9% WoW, timeouts up, small rate-limit hits for a few merchant bursts. Need triage before Tue renewal touchpoint.

omar (SRE): Copy. Any hot endpoints / sample traces? Did they get a new integration or did we roll something?

jess (CSM): No new customer changes on our side. We saw a deploy on Friday (~02:10 UTC) affecting the cheap-model routing. Quick breakdown: 
- overall requests: 1.2M
- 5xx: 106,800 (8.9%)
- timeouts: 18,400 (1.5%)
- rate-limited: 4,800 (0.4%)
Top failing endpoints by 5xx volume: /v1/pay/confirm (~45%), /v1/session/create (~23%), /v1/search (~11%), others small.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Deployed service/payment-worker v2.14.0 at 2026-03-14T02:09:42Z by @ci.

omar (SRE): Thanks — that deploy lines up. Can someone paste example trace ids and a snippet of the confirm latency distribution? Also pinging @infra on whether the worker autoscaler respected queue backlog.

jess (CSM): Trace sample ids: trace-a12, trace-b88, trace-c03 (pasted from customer logs). Aggregate confirm latency (p50/p95/p99): 85ms / 420ms / 1.8s. We used standard timeout 2s; lots of p99 hitting timeout.

omar (SRE): Reproduced in staging with v2.14.0 — there's a path in payment-worker that triggers a synchronous downstream lookup that increased tail latency when cache-miss rate is high. Quick grep: 
```
service: payment-worker
handler: confirmPayment
path: /v1/pay/confirm
synchronous: true
fallback: external-lookup (s3 lookup)
```
If we revert the change in that handler or make the external lookup async/cached we should gain p99.

leah (Onboarding): This is hitting two merchants who were about to go live. One paused and asked for ETA. Renewal sentiment: neutral->concerned. If we don't have a fix by Monday EOD they might delay.

omar (SRE): Plan: roll back payment-worker to v2.13.5 (previous stable) and temporarily increase replicas for confirm handler, enable local cache TTL bump. Rolling now to canary 10% then 100% if healthy. Will monitor errors and latencies.

jess (CSM): Please also monitor sessions endpoint — it's showing correlated errors during peak (~15:30 PST). Might be separate cause (session store).

omar (SRE): For sessions: looks like redis cluster had slot rebalancing warnings around the same deploy window. I opened an infra ticket and flagged ops to increase replica count for redis and pin version.

leah (Onboarding): I'll prepare a short customer note: what happened, mitigation plan, next steps for them. Can we get ETA for full rollback + verification?

omar (SRE): ETA: rollback to v2.13.5 complete by 1945679026 (approx +45m), canary metrics within 15m after. Final verification + postmortem draft by Mon EOD.

jess (CSM): Great. For renewal risk: marking as "medium" for now until rollback proves stable. If errors drop <1% we'll keep on-track. If not, escalate to "high". I'll update account scorecard and schedule the Tue touchpoint but push messaging to hold until we confirm.

ops-bot: alert: error-rate (/v1/pay/confirm) increased 5xx to 47% of service errors at 2026-03-14T02:25:00Z.

omar (SRE): Action items: 
- rollback payment-worker to v2.13.5 (owner: omar)
- bump confirm handler replicas temporarily (owner: omar)
- increase redis replica + monitor rebalancing (owner: infra)
- enable short-term cache on confirm path (owner: omar)
- craft customer update & hold renewal comms (owner: leah)
- update account scorecard (owner: jess)

jess (CSM): I'll draft the account note and send it to @leah and @omar for sign-off. Thanks team — please post short status updates here as actions complete. :spiral_calendar: :white_check_mark:
